messages:
Helen - Hey folks — kicking off Q3 GTM sync. Need topline targets, launch bar for the next PLG experiment, and enablement timing. Who has numbers? :rocket:
Sam - Draft: target 25% uplift in sign-ups MoM, revenue target +18% vs Q2. Need A/B for onboarding flow and a pricing microcopy test.
Raj - Sales: +18% is doable if we free up 2 reps for enterprise handoffs during pilot. Also ask: can we hold launch to avoid big trade shows week?
Ava - Data: I can validate historical conversion delta for onboarding changes. Will share a cohort analysis by EOD tomorrow.
Linda - AE: we need 3 enablement sessions and a deck + playbook. Timeline looks tight if experiment ships in first week of the quarter.
Maria - Content: I'll prep kickoff one-pager, 2 email sequences and 1 hero blog. Prefer 2-week lead time to sync with design and legal.
Sam - Proposed launch criteria (short):
- +5% sign-up conversion in canary
- No critical regressions on latency or cost per token
- Playbook completed & 2 enablement sessions scheduled
Raj - ok to me. Also can we set a fallback plan: roll back to prior onboarding copy if >10% drop in activation?
Helen - yes fallback rule noted. Also add performance SLO: 95th p90 latency under 600ms for hosted flows.
planner-bot - Agenda created: Q3_PLG_experiment, field_enablement, launch_criteria. Meeting scheduled 2026-04-02 16:00 PT.
Ava - I'll produce the cohort report + suggested segments. Recommend targeting new orgs with <200 seats for the experiment.
Maria - tagging @design for hero asset. Also can we record enablement sessions? helps onboarding new sellers.
Linda - +1 record and dump on LMS. Who owns tracking QA during canary?
Sam - @Ava and @Sam will own tracking QA. Sam will handle telemetry dashboards, Ava validates event mapping.
Helen - Action items:
1) Ava: cohort + QA plan by tomorrow EOD
2) Maria: content one-pager draft by Monday
3) Linda: enablement outline + dates by Monday
4) Sam: telemetry and rollback runbook by Monday
5) Raj: confirm rep coverage and trade show conflict by Friday
Confirm if anyone can't commit to those timelines. :eyes:
Raj - I'll confirm rep coverage by Friday morning. :thumbsup:
Ava - on it.
Maria - will share first draft Mon.
Linda - outline Monday.
Sam - will draft telemetry + short rollback doc Monday.
Helen - sweet. We'll use this as the baseline for the Q3 GTM play. Thanks all. :rocket:
